interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised crossings to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and widen the sidewalk where possible to ensure a continuous, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Transit Boarding Island
interventions.description: Install a raised platform to provide a safe, accessible waiting and boarding area for trolley passengers, separating them from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a dedicated furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or large planters to provide a vertical buffer, reduce the heat island effect, and naturally slow traffic through psychological narrowing.

interventions.title: Waste Management
interventions.description: Provide public trash receptacles to reduce the litter visible on the sidewalk and near the bike racks.

interventions.title: Streetscape Buffering
interventions.description: Introduce street trees, planters, or a dedicated furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding a furniture zone with trees or planters would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.
